name: language-switcher
title: Language switcher
description: Picks the interface language: each option named in the current language and sorted by that name, with an optional mark (a flag, a code chip) supplied by the app.

when: The header or sidebar of a product offered in several languages.

builtIn: A listbox with the current language selected and checked.
Names never fall back to the host's language.
A mark is decorative; the name always tells options apart.
youProvide: The product's locales, and names for languages Intl names wrongly (registerLanguageNames).

LanguageSwitcher.name: locales
LanguageSwitcher.description: Locales to offer, already narrowed to what this product enables.

LanguageSwitcher.name: label
LanguageSwitcher.description: The trigger's accessible name and tooltip; "Language" (the DS string) by default.

LanguageSwitcher.name: loading
LanguageSwitcher.description: Hold the disabled trigger while the product's locale list resolves.

LanguageSwitcher.name: sidebar
LanguageSwitcher.description: Layout only: a full-width row whose list opens upward, for a panel sidebar.

LanguageSwitcher.name: collapsed
LanguageSwitcher.description: A collapsed rail: the mark alone (or the name, without one), kept for screen readers either way.

LanguageSwitcher.name: renderMark
LanguageSwitcher.description:
A mark before each language's name: a flag, an `IsoChip`, an icon. None by default: a language is not a
country, and the name alone tells the options apart.

LanguageSwitcher.name: size
LanguageSwitcher.description: Control height: `medium` (default) matches the DS controls, `small` is the compact step.

LanguageSwitcher.name: aria-describedby
LanguageSwitcher.description:
Ids of elements that describe the trigger ("Changes the language of the whole panel"). It lands on the
trigger button, the focusable control, also while it is disabled for `loading`; left out, nothing is
added. While the trigger's tooltip is open it takes the place of the tooltip's id, which only
repeats `label`.
